 Outbreak Fest announces 2027 line-up with ‘ The Hayley Williams Show ’ headlining both days 
 Williams has also curated the line-up which features Dinosaur Jr, Julien Baker, Blood Orange, American Football and many more.
 Photo: Elise Joseph James 
 17th November 2026
Words: A. L. Noonan 
 Outbreak Fest has revealed the first 34 artists for its 2027 edition, with Hayley Williams set to headline both days of the Manchester festival as part of a specially curated programme dubbed ‘The Hayley Williams Show’.
 Taking place at the B.E.C. Arena on 19th and 20th June, the announcement marks the festival’s biggest line-up to date, bringing together artists from across hardcore, punk, indie-rock, hip-hop, shoegaze and electronic music.
 Saturday’s bill includes Blood Orange , Julien Baker , Rico Nasty , Mannequin Pussy and the duo ear , alongside Bren Lukens, Dev Lemons, Lime Garden and Chalk . Hardcore and punk representation comes from Soul Glo, PISS , Snõõper, Reclus.É and Appleseed, among others.
 Sunday sees Dinosaur Jr. make their Outbreak debut, joined by American Football , Wednesday , Citizen , Emma Ogier, Rival Schools and Failure. Returning festival favourites Drug Church, Drain and Angel Du$t also feature, alongside Sweet Pill, Spiritual Cramp and legendary melodic hardcore outfit H2O, who will be playing the festival for the first time.
 The announcement continues Outbreak’s evolution from its hardcore and punk beginnings into a wider celebration of underground music and contemporary counterculture. Previous editions have welcomed artists including Death Grips , Earl Sweatshirt and JPEGMAFIA , while the 2027 programme promises to build on that genre-spanning approach. A further wave of artists is still to come, including the complete Friday programme.
 Outbreak has also confirmed that a portion of proceeds from every ticket will support Medical Aid for Palestinians, Not A Phase and Manchester Central Foodbank. Two-day and day tickets will be available, with weekend ticket holders able to upgrade for the Friday show once its line-up is announced.
 Outbreak Fest 2027 takes place at Manchester’s B.E.C. Arena from 19th–20th June, with further acts still to be announced. Fans can register for presale access here .
